concept: DR strategies: warm standby — scaled-down full copy
tests: Recognizing warm standby: a scaled-down but fully functional copy runs in the second region.
expected: Warm standby — scaled-down fully functional environment that scales up quickly on failover; low RTO/RPO at moderate cost. Triggers: "scaled-down but fully functional copy", "quickly scale up".
why_not: Backup and restore — slow; pilot light — core only; single-region — no DR.
